acceptance.test: python scripts/verify_library.py --local
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 100 qualifying distinct acquired works; every retained PDF matches its recorded hash, size and page count; no count or metadata errors.

acceptance.test: Inspect bibliography/reading-notes.json and run the library validator
acceptance.pass_condition: Every catalogue entry has source-specific findings, formalization use, caution and explicit reading scope; access gaps and duplicate-work exclusions are labeled.

acceptance.test: Build lean/ with Lean 4.19.0 and 4.34.1; run Audit.lean and scripts/check_proofs.py on the emitted output
acceptance.pass_condition: All 22 declared theorems build; audit coverage is exact; no project axioms, proof placeholders, native_decide or unexpected logical dependencies.

acceptance.test: Inspect GitHub visibility, remote commit and the CI run for that commit
acceptance.pass_condition: Public zengrf/lean-historical-linguistics repository matches the local delivery commit; library-and-plan and both Lean jobs pass; only approved PDFs are tracked.

acceptance.test: python scripts/check_plan.py; review docs/04-delivery-plan.md
acceptance.pass_condition: Acyclic milestone graph with explicit artifacts, responsible roles and testable acceptance conditions; future work is marked planned.

title: Evidence schema, provenance and import contract
owner_role: Research engineer with PIE and Sino-Tibetan reviewers

acceptance.test: Implement and run lake exe dossier_check data/pilots --strict
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 30 valid fixtures accepted and 20 adversarial fixtures rejected for the specified reason; no broken references or duplicate primary IDs.

acceptance.test: Original-to-normalized-to-original round-trip and source audit
acceptance.pass_condition: Original strings, tone, combining characters, attestation status, missing/gap/unknown, variants and linked alternatives are retained; every normalization has a versioned record.

acceptance.test: Validate a pinned CLDF import and reconcile imported IDs and counts
acceptance.pass_condition: Every imported record maps to a source record; unsupported fields are reported; round-trip or explicit documented loss policy passes review.

acceptance.test: Independent double-entry review of core forms
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 10 percent of imported core forms and all uncertain OCR/glyph records are independently checked; discrepancies resolved or explicitly flagged.

acceptance.test: Build a total reference interpreter and compare hand-worked derivations
acceptance.pass_condition: Published semantics specify boundaries, contexts, application direction, pass convention, substitution, deletion and rule order; at least 10 independently hand-worked examples match.

acceptance.test: Implement lake build Historical.Rules Historical.Certificates and audit all public theorem dependencies
acceptance.pass_condition: Kernel-checked soundness and completeness connect certificate acceptance exactly to the specified derivation relation; no unproved project axioms.

acceptance.test: Implement lake exe verify_dossiers --suite contextual-rules
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 40 adversarial fixtures exercise missing/extra stages, rule-order changes, context mismatches and feeding versus simultaneous application; each has the expected outcome.

acceptance.test: Review the rule grammar and pilot rule packages
acceptance.pass_condition: No arbitrary unchecked word-specific substitution or hidden lexical lookup is accepted as a regular sound-law explanation.

acceptance.test: Build and audit the alignment checker and preservation theorem
acceptance.pass_condition: Every accepted alignment recovers each original input row after removing alignment gaps; missing cells remain distinct from alignment gaps.

acceptance.test: Check correspondence-group certificates and synthetic counterexamples
acceptance.pass_condition: Pairwise compatibility and positive support are verified; missing-only overlap supplies no support; non-transitive compatibility cannot be treated as equivalence.

acceptance.test: Run the site suite and inspect the per-site report
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 100 sites checked, including 20 incomplete and 10 conflicting cases; each reports group assignment, support, compatibility and checker outcome.

acceptance.test: Inspect all claims of minimal grouping
acceptance.pass_condition: Any minimum-cover claim has a checked optimality certificate; otherwise the result is explicitly feasibility only.

acceptance.test: Build a finite enumeration theorem and inspect the declared hypothesis-space bounds
acceptance.pass_condition: Inventory, maximum word length and any rule/model-choice bounds are explicit; enumeration covers precisely that space.

acceptance.test: Build and audit candidate soundness and relative completeness theorems
acceptance.pass_condition: Every returned candidate fits and every fitting in-scope candidate is returned, relative to the proved executable/logical bridge.

acceptance.test: Build observation-monotonicity and observational-equivalence results; inspect alternative serialization
acceptance.pass_condition: Observationally equivalent histories remain indistinguishable on the selected data; linked alternatives remain joint; monotonicity states fixed model and hypothesis-space assumptions.

acceptance.test: Compare with independent exhaustive enumeration
acceptance.pass_condition: Exact agreement on all words of length at most four over three symbols for at least ten cascades; timeout is distinguished from an empty completed search.

title: Source-backed Indo-European pilot
owner_role: PIE specialist and research engineer; independent PIE reviewer

acceptance.test: Review the source dossiers and check every core derivation
acceptance.pass_condition: 20 cognate sets form an independently reviewed core with source forms, references, chronology, normalization and explicit uncertainty.

acceptance.test: Validate frozen dataset and derivation counts
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 200 cognate sets and 600 reflex records; failed derivations and disagreements remain in the report; numerical targets do not license fabricated data.

acceptance.test: Compare named source-defined rule packages
acceptance.pass_condition: Relative chronology, Anatolian laryngeal evidence and a small morphological dossier have explicit scope; competing analyses and their different predictions are preserved.

acceptance.test: Run the frozen reproduction/generalization protocol from docs/03-case-studies-and-evaluation.md
acceptance.pass_condition: Split manifests are frozen before model revision; reconstruction accuracy, ambiguity, coverage and failure categories are reported separately with leakage checks.

acceptance.test: Obtain independent family-specialist review
acceptance.pass_condition: A reviewer who did not perform the encoding signs off or records unresolved objections; linguistically unreviewed output cannot pass this gate.

title: Sino-Tibetan subgroup and cross-branch pilot
owner_role: Sino-Tibetan specialist and research engineer; independent family reviewer

acceptance.test: Validate and independently review the subgroup core
acceptance.pass_condition: 50 source-backed Kuki-Chin cognate sets checked with source-specific reconstruction levels and exact language/variety identities.

acceptance.test: Validate frozen subgroup data and per-record provenance
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 100 subgroup cognate sets and 300 reflex records; all failed and ambiguous analyses retained.

acceptance.test: Review and execute cross-branch dossiers
acceptance.pass_condition: 30 dossiers record topology assumptions, written versus reconstructed evidence, morphology and relevant competing accounts; unresolved outcomes remain valid results.

acceptance.test: Run frozen evaluation and alternative-analysis comparisons
acceptance.pass_condition: Topology and source-analysis sensitivity are reported; Proto-Tibeto-Burman, Proto-Sino-Tibetan and subgroup nodes are not silently equated.

acceptance.test: Obtain independent family-specialist review
acceptance.pass_condition: A reviewer outside the original encoding signs off or records unresolved objections; absent specialist review, the gate remains unpassed.

title: Verified optimization and external proposal interface

acceptance.test: Build and audit a semantics-preservation theorem
acceptance.pass_condition: Optimized execution equals the reference semantics for a precisely declared fragment; unsupported rules are rejected or handled by the reference interpreter.

acceptance.test: Execute one deterministic baseline and one external proposer
acceptance.pass_condition: Every reported accepted proposal carries a verified certificate; generation success, certificate acceptance and reference-analysis agreement are separate metrics.

acceptance.test: Benchmark 1000 bounded certificates on a documented ordinary laptop
acceptance.pass_condition: Under 60 seconds and under 2 GB peak memory, with software, hardware and bounds recorded; otherwise the target is unpassed and supported batch size is limited.

acceptance.test: Audit the checker boundary and serialized certificate parser
acceptance.pass_condition: External solver, neural or generated-code outputs cannot bypass the verified checker; malformed and corrupted certificates are rejected.

acceptance.test: Build paradigm-aware derivations and typed historical-mechanism witnesses
acceptance.pass_condition: Analogy identifies model forms and affected paradigm relations; borrowing identifies donor/recipient stages and adaptation analysis.

acceptance.test: Independently review and execute the extended case suite
acceptance.pass_condition: At least 20 reviewed cases, including at least five with competing explanations; unresolved cases and initial sound-law failures stay visible.

acceptance.test: Review expressivity and non-identifiability statements
acceptance.pass_condition: No unrestricted exception mechanism forces every word to fit; absence of a unique history is represented explicitly; unrestricted semantic/syntactic reconstruction remains out of scope.

title: Independent research release
owner_role: Research lead, independent reproducer and release maintainer

acceptance.test: One-command clean-environment reproduction by a second person in a second environment
acceptance.pass_condition: Main theorem audits and frozen case-study results reproduce with documented resource use and no unrecorded local inputs.

acceptance.test: Inspect tagged artifact archive and manifest
acceptance.pass_condition: Code, toolchains, datasets, source versions, rules, splits, checksums and permissions are frozen and documented.

acceptance.test: Review the release paper against evidence and acceptance reports
acceptance.pass_condition: Claims distinguish mathematical correctness, empirical reproduction, prediction and interpretation; unpassed gates and unresolved analyses remain explicit.

acceptance.test: If the optional probability module is pursued, audit its finite rational posterior theorem and empirical calibration report
acceptance.pass_condition: Either explicitly deferred without blocking the core release, or normalization/calculation proved with priors, likelihood assumptions, sensitivity and calibration evaluated separately.
